canonical_entailment_rationale: Frontend tests at the appropriate level, not Angular internals, few important E2E workflows, no duplication across levels, configured runner: elaborations of the narrowest-level (TST-002), behavior (TST-003) and low-value-test (TST-011) policies; the runner follows repository configuration. Claim: "Test frontend behaviour at the appropriate level (component behaviour, validation, data-access mapping, route/auth behaviour, complex state); do not test Angular internals; E2E covers a small number of important workflows unless broader coverage is required; do not duplicate the same behaviour at every level; use the test runner configured in package.json.". Policy text: TST-002: "Choose the narrowest test level that meaningfully verifies the behavior; use integration tests when framework/persistence/HTTP wiring is the subject; no fixed unit/integration ratio is required."; TST-003: "Tests should verify observable behavior and normally survive internal refactoring; avoid testing private calls or reproducing implementation algorithms."; TST-011: "Do not generate low-value tests merely to increase coverage percentage."
claim_text: Test frontend behaviour at the appropriate level (component behaviour, validation, data-access mapping, route/auth behaviour, complex state); do not test Angular internals; E2E covers a small number of important workflows unless broader coverage is required; do not duplicate the same behaviour at every level; use the test runner configured in package.json.
exceptions: Broader E2E when the project requires it.
